cryptoBackend.name: AWS-LC mldsa-native / mlkem-native via aws-lc-sys (rust/src/crypto/awslc_pq.rs: ML-KEM decapsulation, ML-DSA pure and external-mu verification) with RustCrypto fips204 (patched) for HashML-DSA and as the fallback, and ml-kem (patched) as the ML-KEM fallback

acceleration.detail: none for every tested operation (ML-KEM decapsulation; ML-DSA pure, HashML-DSA and external-mu verification), established by source reading of the engine at hsm 7f12c48d5e406c075076b5ea2eaf2d2de63c879b, the image's build-time commit: ML-KEM decapsulation rust/src/crypto/handlers.rs:1700-1713 -> AWS-LC (rust/src/crypto/awslc_pq.rs:585-587) or ml-kem; ML-DSA pure/HashML-DSA verification handlers.rs:2824-2840 and external-mu verification handlers.rs:1495-1517 -> AWS-LC or fips204 verify_internal (rust/fips204-patched/src/ml_dsa.rs:559-561, plain expand_a/mat_vec_mul, no hook); the only fips204 hooks the engine installs are the ML-DSA-65 sign hook (rust/src/hw_accel.rs:177), the ML-DSA-65 matvec hook used only by keygen/sign (hw_accel.rs:344; ml_dsa.rs:134, 360) and a diagnostics-only stage-timing hook (hw_accel.rs:255); the ExpandA hook is installed only by a cfg(test) test (rust/fips204-patched/src/hashing.rs:43); the hashsig profile loaded on this board (bitstream 619571de) hooks only SLH-DSA/LMS/XMSS (hw_accel.rs:396-419). C_Initialize runs the hashsig probe/KAT (hw_accel.rs:311-388), which is not a tested operation; a separate C_Initialize on this board with PQC_HW_DIAGNOSTICS=1 reported both ML-DSA probes failing (FPGA UIO device not found) and hooks: SLH_SIGN, SLH_KEYGEN only.

Its [provider_sect] names only default (activate commented out, so the default provider is loaded implicitly); its .include /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf.d is an empty directory; no engine is configured; OPENSSL_MODULES is unset (/usr/lib/ossl-modules holds pkcs11.so, never activated). The Rust engine maps no libcrypto into the runner process (dependencies.openssl), so this configuration does not reach it; recorded for completeness.
